title: fullmark review (version 1)
description: The file quiz review writes: the learner's verdict on each question. Only quiz review writes it; agents read it and never edit it. New optional fields keep version 1.

source_hash.description: Hash of the whole quiz source at the last review.

items.description: Keyed by the question id at review time.

hash.description: First 16 hex characters of SHA-256 of the question's normalized source block.

text.description: What should change (fix) or why (drop); empty for keep.
